name: Chengdu Leejun Industrial Co., Ltd.
summary: Chengdu Leejun Industrial Co., Ltd. researches and develops, designs, manufactures, sells, and services grinding process system equipment in the People's Republic of China and internationally. The company offers roller presses, high-pressure roller mills, roller systems, air classifiers, aerospace parts manufacturing, used in industries such as cement and building materials, mining, metallurgy, and chemicals.
